svg.text: K-100 EXPORT GAS COMPRESSOR (1 CASING · 2 SECTIONS · 1 SHAFT)
* AT THE SURGE LINE q = 0.62, DESIGN SPEED (FULL RECYCLE CASE)
CONTROL VALVE (DCS) · FC / FO = FAIL CLOSED / OPEN
ESDV / BDV / XV ON-OFF VALVE (SIS), FAIL AS MARKED
REMOTE HAND VALVE HV (HIC IN THE DCS)
SIS TRIP FUNCTION (LOGIC SOLVER SEPARATE FROM DCS)
LEADER: SIS ON A DCS BUBBLE SHARES ITS TRANSMITTER
INSTRUMENT SIGNAL (ONLY TRIP / SOLENOID LINKS DRAWN)
PG PROCESS GAS · EG EXPORT GAS · FG FUEL GAS · FL FLARE
CD CLOSED DRAIN · CM COOLING MEDIUM · STREAM n = PFD / PROCESS TAB
INTERLOCK SCHEDULE (SIS) · FROM THE OTS C&E DATA
I-1 COMPRESSOR TRIP (PSD): XV-100 FUEL SHUT (GT COASTS DOWN), ESDV-101 + ESDV-113 SHUT,
UV-103 / UV-108 100 % OPEN (UIC TO MAN), PIC-101 + SIC-100 TO MAN (SIC OUT 0 %),
PIC-102 OUTPUT ≥ 80 % (PRODUCTION TO FLARE). LATCHED, FIRST-OUT ON THE SIS TAB.
I-2 = I-1 + BDV-101 / BDV-112 OPEN (RO 45 mm) + XV-001 SHUT (WELLS SHUT IN).
XV-001: PSHH-001 SHUTS THE WELLS ONLY (NO I-1); REOPEN BELOW 33.5 barg.
TRIPS ACT IN RUN / START; RESET REFUSED WHILE A CAUSE HOLDS OR SPEED > 5 %.
DESIGN POINT (OTS MODEL, NOTE 1) · SHAFT 16.69 MW · 9 500 rpm
1. DESIGN BASIS (ASSUMED FOR TRAINING, TBC): 200 MMSCFD (61.75 kg/s) GULF OF THAILAND GAS, MW 22.3 (CO2 12 %), γ 1.258; 30 → 120 barg; N = 2 SECTIONS,
r = 3.96^(1/2) = 1.99 EACH (ONE STAGE: T2 ≈ 192 °C > SEAL CEILING 150 °C). Ep FROM LECTURE CHART; T2 = T1·r^((γ−1)/(γ·Ep)). NUMBERS = OTS DESIGN POINT.
MASS BALANCE 61.75 IN = 60.25 EXPORT + 1.38 FUEL + 0.11 CONDENSATE (+0.005 ACCUMULATION) kg/s; V-101 LIQUIDS 0.22 kg/s ARRIVE WITH THE GAS.
2. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY: VELOCITY AT DN BORE, CRITERIA v ≤ 20 m/s AND ρv² ≤ 15 000 Pa (ASSUMED); ALL ≤ 10.8 m/s AND ≤ 7 500 Pa. FLARE LINES: HOLD (FLARE STUDY).
3. SETTLE-OUT AFTER A TRIP ≈ 69 barg (MODEL): SUCTION SIDE (V-101, SECTION 1) DESIGN PRESSURE 80 barg (TBC). PSV-107 80 barg ON V-102 AND PSV-112 138 barg
ON THE DISCHARGE: HOLD (NOT DRAWN). BLOWDOWN COOLS BY EXPANSION: FLARE AND BLOWDOWN LINES LTCS, MDMT −46 °C (TBC).
4. UIC-103/108 SURGE MARGIN = (q/q_SURGE − 1)·100 % FROM FT, PT, TT; CONTROL LINE 10 %; FAST OPEN BELOW 5 %. UV-103/108 ALSO HAVE ZI-103/108 (POSITION).
5. CASCADE: PIC-101 (SUCTION) → SIC-100 SPEED SP (0–100 % = 70–105 %) → FV-100 FUEL. DCS SIGNAL LINES NOT DRAWN; EACH DCS BUBBLE HAS ITS OWN
TRANSMITTER (PT/TT/LT/FT/VT, SAME NUMBER, e.g. TT-106 FOR TIC-106). PSHH-001 SHARES PT-001 (PIC-102), PSLL-101 PT-101 (PIC-101), SSHH-100 THE SPEED PICK-UP.
6. FUEL GAS FROM V-102 OUTLET VIA FUEL-GAS SKID (PCV TO 25 barg, HEATER, FILTER NOT SHOWN). LUBE-OIL CONSOLE, SEAL-GAS PANEL, CM SYSTEM (P-160, TI-160): VENDOR / SEPARATE SHEETS.
7. DRAINS MV-130…133 TO CLOSED DRAIN, VENTS MV-134/135 BLINDED; ALL OTHER HIGH-POINT VENTS / LOW-POINT DRAINS DN25 (TYP., NOT SHOWN). INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT & TEST VALVES.
A. START-UP: PRESSURISE WITH HV-101 UNTIL ΔP ACROSS ESDV-101 ≤ 3 bar,
OPEN ESDV-101, START GT-100 ON FULL RECYCLE. GT PERMISSIVES: SIS READY,
B. AFTER A PSD THE LOOP SETTLES OUT: VENT WITH HV-102 TO HEADER PRESSURE
C. ANTI-SURGE, FLARE AND BLOWDOWN VALVES ARE CHOKED WHEN P2/P1 < 0.553.
D. P-150B STANDBY LUBE-OIL PUMP AUTO-STARTS AT PI-150 1.8 barg (BPCS).
E. HOLD / TBC: PSV-107, PSV-112, FLARE LINE SIZES, HV-101/102 FAIL POSITION
(FC ASSUMED), DESIGN PRESSURES, CM SIDE (E-101 7.3 MW, E-102 7.7 MW).
F. REV B = ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD). REV A STAYS THE SCREEN
REFERENCE USED BY THE DCS, THE DECKS AND THE EXERCISES; SAME TAGS.
SCREEN REFERENCE USED BY THE DCS, DECKS AND EXERCISES
